text:
Mario Chen: Heads-up — CI perf gates flagged a regression on reranker/emb endpoints for non-chat traffic after the kernel selector change.
Karen Patel: ugh, which change? the cheap-kernel fallback from last week? :thinking: 
Mario Chen: yeah. noticed higher KV cache evictions and smaller batch formation for short queries. throughput down ~9% on p99 sequences.
Ben O'Neill: Can you paste the perf output?
Mario Chen: Quick snapshot from staging run: 
```
slotting: shifted-firstfit
avg_batch_size: 5.8 (target 8)
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.71 -> 0.63
kernel_choice: fast_fp16 -> fallback_int8 (20% of ops)
tokens_per_second: -12%
p99_lat_ms: +18ms
token_budget_overshoot: 1.37x
```
Samira Lopez: That token_budget_overshoot stands out. Sounds like the continuous batcher is filling windows with too many short requests and then forcing kernel fallback due to kernel memory spike?
Karen Patel: Agreed. Also saw queue shuffles from first-fit when slot fragmentation increases; first-fit tends to place small requests in early slots leaving holes.
Ben O'Neill: Ideas: 1) hysteresis on KV eviction decisions (delay evict for small refills), 2) bias batch formation to pack by seq_len bucket before first-fit, 3) enforce token_budget per-slot.
Mario Chen: I prototyped a patch: prefer-fit-with-shift windowing + max_tokens_per_slot=4096 and soft_kv_hysteresis=0.2. Staging numbers: avg_batch_size 7.9, kv_hit 0.69, tokens/sec -3%, p99 +6ms.
Samira Lopez: much better. Can you share the proto config?
Mario Chen: Config snippet: 
```
batcher:
  strategy: shifted_firstfit
  shift_stride: 128
  prepack_by: seq_len_bucket
  max_tokens_per_slot: 4096
  soft_kv_hysteresis: 0.2
kernel_selector:
  memory_threshold_pct: 0.85
  allow_fallback_ratio: 0.05
```
Ben O'Neill: Nice. Two follow-ups: run a long tail sim with Zipf workloads and add kernel selection trace for samples that triggered fallback. Also check if allow_fallback_ratio=0.05 causes too many FP->INT migrations under burst.
Karen Patel: Also add a metric for "slot_fragmentation" so we can alert when avg holes per window > 2.
perf-bot: perf-gate: rerank-embeds: STAGE -> baseline diff: tokens/sec -3.1%, p99 +5.8ms, avg_batch +36% :eyes:
Samira Lopez: I'll queue a canary job with the shifted_firstfit config and Zipf-10 traffic for 6 hours. If stable, we should ship to canary and enable slot_fragmentation alarms.
Mario Chen: Thanks — I'll instrument kernel traces and KV eviction timelines.
Ben O'Neill: If canary looks good, we should also add an A/B to test with and without soft_kv_hysteresis (0.0 vs 0.2) to ensure no accuracy/latency regression.
Karen Patel: Sounds like a plan. @Samira please post results here when the job finishes. :thumbsup:
Mario Chen: FYI I put the debug command in ops runbook: 
```
# pull kernel & kv traces for a request id
curl -sS https://staging-logs/api/trace?req_id=<id> | jq .kernel_decisions,.kv_events
```
Samira Lopez: will do. putting job in queue now.
Mario Chen: closing loop — any objections to merging the shifted_firstfit prototype into staging branch after canary?
Ben O'Neill: none from me.
Karen Patel: no objections.
perf-bot: alert: canary job queued by Samira Lopez (zipf-10, 6h).
